ValidationRule.description: Only allows users to enter their own name in the Internal Credit Analyst field. Excepts System Administrators and users with Customer Settings ValidationRules permission Reassign Credit Analyst.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Internal_Credit_Analyst__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Reassign_Credit_Analyst__c = FALSE, Internal_Credit_Analyst__c <> $User.Id ), AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Reassign_Credit_Analyst__c = FALSE, ISCHANGED(Internal_Credit_Analyst__c), Internal_Credit_Analyst__c = $User.Id, NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Internal_Credit_Analyst__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Users can only enter their own name in the Internal Credit Analyst field and cannot reassign it.
